data.title: Thai FDA, Poland’s URPL advance landmark regulatory pact
data.description: Thailand’s Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and Poland’s Office for Registration of Medicinal Products (URPL) are advancing plans to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to strengthen cooperation in health product regulation, knowledge exchange, and capacity building between the two agencies.

data.title: Dozens feared trapped in quake-hit Japan mall
data.description: TOKYO - Dozens of people were feared trapped in a shopping mall in Japan on Tuesday after a major earthquake toppled buildings, sparked fires and reportedly killed one person and injured more than 100.

data.title: Family seeks help to find Thai YouTuber missing in Georgia
data.description: The family of YouTuber Hlun Solo has appealed for help after he went missing while travelling alone in Georgia to film content, with no contact made for the past two weeks.

data.title: Malaysia busts scam centres in Forest City
data.description: KUALA ​LUMPUR - Malaysian police have raided 32 premises hosting online ​scam activities in Forest ‌City in the state of Johor, arresting 335 people and seizing assets worth about 1 million ringgit ($245,000), the state police chief said on Tuesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali promises ‘beast is coming’ after heated Ramadan Ondash face-off
data.description: Johan Ghazali has promised to ride the wave created in Malaysia by Aliff Sor Dechapan’s historic ONE Championship title triumph – and unleash “the beast” against Ramadan Ondash in Friday’s Inner Circle 24 co-main event.

data.title: Anutin brushes off Bhumjaithai rift talk
data.description: Prime Minister and Bhumjaithai Party leader Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed speculation about divisions among the party’s key figures, insisting there are no conflicts within the party and no need for reconciliation talks.

data.title: Thailand steps up Japan drug smuggling probe
data.description: Thai authorities are continuing to coordinate with their Japanese counterparts over the case of a 28-year-old Thai woman arrested at Fukuoka Airport after crystal methamphetamine was found hidden in coffee sachets she was carrying into Japan.

data.title: France turns to Zidane to bring football glory
data.description: PARIS - ​Zinedine Zidane will take charge of France with ‌the weight of history behind him and one of world football’s most gifted squads in front of him, as the 1998 World Cup hero returns to the national team tasked with turning recent near-misses into trophies.

data.title: Firefighters on the offensive in France and Spain
data.description: LEGE-CAP-FERRET, France - Firefighters in France and Spain rushed to contain the worst wildfires in living memory on Tuesday, seizing crucial hours before the arrival of another wave brings scorching temperatures.

data.title: Social Security board election ‘not postponed’
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has insisted that the election for the Social Security Office (SSO) board has not been postponed, but only temporarily halted after the Supreme Administrative Court issued an injunction, which the SSO plans to appeal.

data.title: 7.1 earthquake strikes Japan’s Kyushu region
data.description: TOKYO - An earthquake with a ​preliminary magnitude of 7.1 struck Kumamoto prefecture in southern Japan on Tuesday, knocking out power to thousands of homes, stopping rail services and triggering warnings for tsunamis and aftershocks.

data.title: PM says Senate case no threat to coalition
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns that allegations of collusion in the Senate election could undermine the coalition government’s stability.

data.title: Thailand Cuts Botulism Drug Cost by 90% in Major Medical Breakthrough
data.description: A non-profit Thai scientific coalition has developed a local botulism antitoxin, slashing treatment costs and positioning the nation as a regional hub

data.title: Former bank manager held after two slain in land dispute
data.description: A former bank manager has been arrested after shooting five relatives, killing two and injuring three, in a long-running dispute over an access road in Bang Bua Thong district of Nonthaburi on Tuesday.

data.title: Two Chinese burglary suspects arrested at Suvarnabhumi
data.description: Two Chinese nationals wanted in connection with a series of luxury home burglaries in Nonthaburi province have been arrested at Suvarnabhumi airport after returning to Thailand.

data.title: Plan B Illuminates Bangkok Historic Landmark with Royal Tribute
data.description: Plan B Media transforms the newly renovated Sathit Thai Chayo Building with projection mapping to mark His Majesty the King’s birthday

data.title: TSD breach exposes 200,000 investors to fraud and impersonation risks
data.description: Leaked TSD Investor Portal data includes ID, contact, brokerage and bank account details, but securities holdings and transactions remain unaffected

data.title: ‘Appy marriages’: AI helps more Japanese to wed
data.description: TOKYO - A total of 265 couples have married after meeting on an AI-powered dating app launched by the Tokyo government in 2024 to lift Japan’s low birth rate, according to official data.

data.title: Civilian killings on the rise in Myanmar
data.description: Myanmar’s military has sharply escalated attacks on civilians since a new administration took office in the war-torn country, a conflict monitor said on Monday, even as regional governments ramp up diplomatic engagement.

data.title: Wildlife face ‘catastrophic’ losses in French blazes
data.description: PARIS - Deer trapped by walls of flame, lizards unable to escape the heat, habitats reduced to charred wood and ash: wildlife are paying a steep price as France's forests burn.

data.title: Police to quiz two senior officials over exam fraud
data.description: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) will summon two senior officials for questioning over their alleged roles in the local government recruitment exam fraud after investigators found evidence linking them to the scheme.

data.title: Major shake-up at Agriculture and Cooperatives Ministry
data.description: The cabinet on Monday approved a major reshuffle of nine senior Agriculture and Cooperatives Ministry officials.

data.title: People's Party blasts civil service reform plan
data.description: People's Party deputy leader Sirikanya Tansakun has urged the government to rethink its proposed early retirement scheme for civil servants, arguing that it has put the cart before the horse by prioritising workforce reductions before deciding which state agencies should be merged or abolished.

data.title: Sudan militia leader ‘unleashes’ fighters after army gains
data.description: EL-OBEID, Sudan - Sudan paramilitary leader Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, whose Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have been accused of genocide, told his fighters Monday to consider themselves “unleashed” in their war against the army.

data.title: Brazil's Amazonia theatres earn World Heritage status
data.description: BRASíLIA - Unesco on Monday added Brazil's Theatro da Paz and Teatro Amazonas to its World Heritage list.

data.title: AI cameras spot suicide attempts in Seoul
data.description: SEOUL - When AI-powered cameras on bridges over Seoul's Han River raise the alarm that someone may be about to jump, acting quickly is vital.

data.title: UN lists South Sudan antelope route as heritage in danger
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - The United Nations has fast-tracked a vast antelope migration path in South Sudan onto its list of World Heritage in Danger, in the young nation's first such listing.

data.description: EL-OBEID (SUDAN) - Sudan paramilitary leader Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, whose Rapid Support Forces have been accused of genocide, told his fighters Monday to consider themselves "unleashed" in their war against the army.

data.title: UK funeral director faces jail over bodies left 'on racks'
data.description: KINGSTON UPON HULL (UNITED KINGDOM) - A British funeral director faced prison Monday over a scandal that saw bodies left "stored on racks" and uncremated while relatives were handed other people's ashes, sparking calls for better regulation of the industry.

data.title: Cabinet backs VAT cut extension to 2027
data.description: The cabinet has approved in principle a one-year extension of the country's 7% value-added tax (VAT) rate until Sept 30, 2027, in a move aimed at easing living costs, stimulating consumer spending and supporting economic stability.
